description:
Query raw Bitcoin transactions and optionally attach inputs and outputs inline.

COMMON USER ASKS:
- Recent Bitcoin transactions
- Attach inputs and outputs

WHEN TO USE:
- You need raw Bitcoin transaction records.
- You want the UTXO envelope without switching to separate input/output tools.

DON'T USE:
- You only need a quick wallet or network summary.

EXAMPLES:
- Recent Bitcoin transactions: {"network":"bitcoin-mainnet","timeframe":"1h","limit":20}
- Attach inputs and outputs: {"network":"bitcoin-mainnet","timeframe":"1h","include_inputs":true,"include_outputs":true,"limit":10}

cursor.description: Continuation cursor from a previous response

from_timestamp.description: Starting timestamp. Accepts Unix seconds, Unix milliseconds, ISO datetime, or relative input like "1h ago".

limit.description: Max transactions to return (default: 20, max: 25). With include_inputs or include_outputs and response_format "full", a page near the maximum can exceed the 50,000-byte response budget; the response_too_large error then names the limit to retry with.

network.description: Network name (default: bitcoin-mainnet). Optional when continuing with cursor.

response_format.description: Response format: defaults to 'compact' for chat-friendly output. Compact mode keeps inline inputs and outputs in a smaller shape when requested.

to_timestamp.description: Ending timestamp. Accepts Unix seconds, Unix milliseconds, ISO datetime, or relative input like "now".
